source.selection: covered by the case domain, more than 15 m from every rated route line

elevation: Bare-earth lidar road estimate, not a surveyed road or bridge deck.
encoding: Station i: id = lines.id[line] + ":" + stationDm. stationDm, lonE6, latE6 are running sums of dDm, dLonE6, dLatE6 from 0 over all stations. roadZCm is a running sum of dZCm over non-null entries; null = no road height. lines.start[k] is the first station of line k. flags are 0 except at flags.index. A line is also its polyline.
